items: Report module renders supplied analysis dictionaries into Markdown-style summaries/recommendations; it does not itself execute experiments.
Analysis statistical module supplies paired/effect utilities and a RECA hypothesis-evaluation interface returning sample/feature/hypothesis metadata.
Hypothesis evaluator does not itself specify a fitted predictive/causal model or full uncertainty decision rule.
Trajectory analysis computes moving summaries, perturbation response and a heuristic viability-expansion quantity.
Heuristic scale/range and identity with theoretical G_V remain unresolved.
Metrics package initializer defines metric import/export surface.
Recursive-depth metric classifies/aggregates supplied structural-event categories rather than discovering mechanism identity directly.
Event labels require external validation as evidence of true recursive mechanism depth.
Consequence-coupling metric estimates association from supplied consequence/change-feature records and includes a shuffled-consequence sanity check.
Association plus shuffle control does not itself identify causal consequence authority.
Adaptive-consolidation metric estimates retention/persistence of supplied adaptive structural information.
Retention does not establish usefulness or causal contribution to later viability.
Composite module stores D_c/C_e/A_c values and combines them into a product-style RECA score.
Product combination assumes compatible scaling and interaction semantics not established by the function.
Viability module computes heuristic current/future adaptive estimates from supplied trajectory/performance/perturbation values.
Implemented viability proxy requires construct validation against theoretical G_V/future adaptive capacity.
Metric statistical helpers compute raw correlation-style relationships and fixed magnitude/direction labels.
Correlation labels do not implement the full documented uncertainty/effect-size/multi-seed inference doctrine.
Pytest source contains deterministic unit assertions for current metric helpers.
Metric unit-test assertions are software-level checks, not benchmark-level scientific tests of RECA.
No persisted pytest/CI record establishes execution/pass standing at the frozen head.
